body.p: Please replace the paragraph beginning at page 6, line 15, of the Specification with the following rewritten paragraph:
In another aspect of the present invention a cavity determination computer

program for determining a cavity within an object is presented, wherein the computer program comprises program code means for causing a cavity determination apparatus se defined in claim 1 to carry out the steps of the a cavity determination method as defined in claim 14, described herein when the computer program is run on a computer controlling the cavity determination apparatus.
Please replace the paragraph beginning at page 6, line 21, of the Specification with the following rewritten paragraph:
It shall be understood that the cavity determination apparatus of claim 1, the

cavity determination method of claim 14 and the cavity determination computer program claim 15 ofthindependent claims have similar and/or identical preferred embodiments, in particular, as defined in the dependent claims.
